body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Enspert(www.enspert.com) participated to the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA for 4 days from January 6.
Enspert introduced 'E301', the next version of 'E201', smart home hub device 'S200U' and Tablet PC 'E501' which is going to be loaded Google's Android 3.0(Honeycomb).
Enspert will hit targeting overseas market with CES 2011 as a fiducial line. For this, it's orgernizing the exporting consulting with Japan and American companies at many exhibitions.
(Picture: Tablet PC 'E501' which is going to be loaded Honeycomb)
